docs.summary: Live view of [`FrameStats`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStats): a scrolling chart stacked by category over a table of every category. Single frames go past too fast to read, so frames are gathered into one column per refresh interval. Click a column to pause on it, and a category to hide it from the chart. Categories with subcategories show as one group that expands into them, with an Other row for the parent's own time.
